causal_order_key.ordering: physical history direction first; within identical physical time order by causal_sequence, then causal_phase, then stable record ID
causal_order_key.stable_identity_rule: The key is explicit, serialized, replay-stable, and derived from the existing activation event identity and frozen model; it is never inferred from insertion, filename, hash, or mtime order.

legacy_compatibility.records_without_causal_binding: Implicit BASE phase only when no event relation binds the record to a causal phase.
legacy_compatibility.pre_event_binding: The immutable transition event before_state_ids relation binds the existing T1 state as PRE_EVENT; historical T1 bytes and identity are not rewritten.
legacy_compatibility.multiple_causal_states_without_selector: Return CONFLICT with reason AMBIGUOUS_CAUSAL_STATE; never choose latest insertion.

query_contract.selector: Optional causal_phase and causal_event_id independent of exact physical time.
query_contract.state_at: Filter by physical time and optional causal selector; ambiguity remains fail-closed.
query_contract.history: Order states by physical history direction, then causal sequence within one exact time, then deterministic stable ID.
query_contract.difference: Compare explicit selected state IDs; PRE_EVENT to POST_EVENT is a valid same-time difference.
query_contract.why: Expose activation predicate -> frozen model -> process-state successor, using explicit event and before/after references.
query_contract.support: Resolve membership by selected causal state; identical membership reports PRESERVED_MEMBERSHIP_WITH_NEW_CAUSAL_VERSION.
query_contract.replay: Accept explicit event/model/version references; no ordering from write sequence.
query_contract.unknown: Preserve UNKNOWN and its support class independently at each causal phase.
query_contract.temporal_validity: Represent zero-duration causal successor without extending the prior Euler validity interval.

minimum_implementation_targets: causal binding schema or event-derived causal binding adapter for state records
query selector and fail-closed ambiguity reason
history ordering by exact physical time plus causal sequence
tests for legacy single-state queries, same-time PRE/POST selection, omitted-selector conflict, deterministic ordering, and reopen/replay stability
